info.name: Task1 Products API
info.description:
1. GET All Products  
    GET → [http://localhost:5000/products](http://localhost:5000/products)
    
2. GET Single Product  
    GET → [http://localhost:5000/products/:id](http://localhost:5000/products/:id)
    
3. POST Create Product  
    POST → [http://localhost:5000/products](http://localhost:5000/products)  
    Body → { "name": "iPhone 15", "price": 79999, "stock": 50 }
    
4. PUT Update Product  
    PUT → [http://localhost:5000/products/:id](http://localhost:5000/products/:id)  
    Body → { "name": "iPhone 15 Pro", "price": 89999, "stock": 40, "description": "Updated" }
    
5. PATCH Partial Update  
    PATCH → [http://localhost:5000/products/:id](http://localhost:5000/products/:id)  
    Body → { "price": 75000 }
    
6. DELETE Product  
    DELETE → [http://localhost:5000/products/:id](http://localhost:5000/products/:id)
    
7. GET Invalid ID (Error Test)  
    GET → [http://localhost:5000/products/invalidid123](http://localhost:5000/products/invalidid123)
